title: miaomiao2: could retrieve libre history from blukon be applied? Not working now
symptom: When Miaomiao2 disconnects for more than 10 minutes, it loses readings and does not retrieve Libre history on reconnection, unlike Blucon which does. The user has enabled 'retrieving libre history' but it does not work with MM2.
evidence_quote: The issue is that if the disconnection lasts more than 10 minutes, it will loose readings. I have activated "retrieving libre history" just in case it could work with MM2, but it is not the case.
